data.title: The site lives at the root of https://split-bill.bysavelii.com on the project VM (bysavelii/server, sites/split-bill) and is deployed by the workflow CI from main as the image ghcr.io/bysavelii/split-bill:<sha>; GitHub Pages is turned off, and old links to bysavelii.github.io/split-bill/ no longer open
data.description: The owner chose to move the app to its own domain next to the other sites on the VM and to drop the GitHub Pages copy instead of keeping a redirect
